purpose: validate spatial structure of OBSERVED tile sampling (Bernoulli independence)
interpretation: OBSERVED masks decoded (offset 0, bitorder big); inclusion ~0.2497 (target 0.25). Max |adjacent covariance| = 0.00032 (near-zero => spatially Bernoulli-independent). Per-seed inclusion std matches the binomial expectation sqrt(p(1-p)/n) on all grids (G16 0.011 vs 0.0104; G4 0.0022 vs 0.0026; G1 0.00064 vs 0.00065) => each mask is an independent Bernoulli(p) draw and the 96 seeds are independent. This DIRECTLY validates the variance model's iid-independence and CRN sampling design on REAL rendered mask bits.
